blocks.text: CAMALIG, ALBAY, Philippines — About 8,000 people attended the opening of the Christmas Village at Sumlang Lake, where the majestic Mayon Volcano served as the backdrop to the colorful Christmas decorations and festive displays. The lakeside attraction featured towering Christmas installations, colorful displays and a three-minute fireworks show during the opening ceremony on Monday, Nov. 16. Visitors from Albay and Camarines Sur also had the opportunity to take photos with mascots dressed as Santa Claus, Frosty the Snowman and other Christmas characters.
